title: Engineering a High-Throughput Async Payroll Engine with Celery & Django
description: How to design a scale-tested, transactionally secure payroll engine that solves float inaccuracies, database deadlocks, and CPU-bound worker bottlenecks using Django, Celery, and PostgreSQL.

title: Context Engineering: Building Secure LLM Tool Gates with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: An in-depth look at Context Engineering—the art of dynamically feeding clean, structured database, repo, and container data into LLM context windows using FastAPI and custom MCP servers.

title: Agentic AI Architectures: Designing Reliable Multi-Agent Workflows in Production
description: An architectural deep-dive reviewing multi-agent coordination patterns—including Hierarchical Supervisors, Debate Swarms, and Stateful Flowcharts using LangGraph and Temporal.io.

title: Multi-Agent AI Is Not a Buzzword — It Is a Software Architecture Shift
description: Why one massive system prompt fails, why separation of responsibilities matters, and how to transition from prompt templates to multi-agent architectures.

title: Workflow vs. Agent vs. Multi-Agent System: Defining the Boundaries
description: Deconstructing the autonomy spectrum. When to use deterministic code paths, LLM workflows, single agents, or collaborative multi-agent swarms.

title: The Multi-Agent Architecture That Actually Ships: Orchestrator → Worker → Validator
description: A deep dive into decoupled worker contexts and validator contracts that eliminate LLM self-evaluation bias and stabilize production AI systems.
